title: Project Overview
description: Start with the README to understand Fladder: a cross-platform Jellyfin frontend built with Flutter, targeting Android, iOS, Linux, macOS, Windows, and Web.

title: Application Entry Point
description: main.dart boots the Flutter app. It initializes services, sets up Riverpod providers, and launches the platform-appropriate wrapper.

title: Core Data Models
description: ItemBaseModel is the foundation of the data layer. All Jellyfin items (movies, series, episodes, albums) extend from it. Models use Freezed for immutability and json_serializable for JSON mapping.

title: API Integration (Chopper)
description: The Jellyfin API client is generated from OpenAPI specs. client_index.dart exports the Chopper service, and jellyfin_open_api.swagger.dart contains the full typed API surface.

title: State Management (Riverpod)
description: Riverpod providers form the business logic layer. api_provider wraps the Chopper client, auth_provider handles login/session, and user_provider manages user state. Each provider is a StateNotifier or AsyncNotifier.

title: Navigation and Routing
description: auto_router.dart defines the full navigation graph using the auto_route package. Routes are code-generated in auto_router.gr.dart, enabling type-safe page transitions across all screens.

title: UI Layer: Screens
description: Screens are organized by feature: login, dashboard, library, details_screens, video_player, settings, live_tv, and seerr. Each screen consumes Riverpod providers and builds the widget tree.

title: Video Player and Media Playback
description: The video player layer wraps platform-specific players (MDK, MPV, native) behind a base_player abstraction. video_player_provider orchestrates playback state, queue, and subtitle handling.

title: Platform-Specific Code
description: Each platform has native code: Android uses Kotlin for ExoPlayer integration and leanback TV support, iOS/macOS use Swift, Linux uses C++, and Windows uses C++. Pigeon handles Flutter-to-native communication.

title: Offline Sync and Background Services
description: sync_provider.dart manages offline content downloads and playback. background_download_provider handles queue and progress. Items are stored locally with Drift for offline access.

title: Theme and Adaptive Layout
description: theme.dart defines the visual language. adaptive_layout.dart adjusts the UI for phone, tablet, desktop, and TV form factors. The navigation_scaffold provides the app shell.

title: Configuration and Build Infrastructure
description: pubspec.yaml declares dependencies and build variants (development, production). CI/CD runs via GitHub Actions. Docker support enables headless server deployment. l10n.yaml configures internationalization across 30+ languages.
